split: sort episode seeds ascending; first 50 calibration, last 50 validation; each run must have 100 distinct seeds
metric: For each consecutive 10-control-step window whose original and placed flags are all true, minimum TCP-to-nearest-cube distance over both arms and all 10 steps. Episode statistic is maximum over these windows; no valid window gives null (never counts as withdrawal).
threshold_rule: Per task max(fixed floor: ms=0.12 m/rf=0.15 m, largest calibration episode statistic across all four methods + 0.01 m).
validation_denominators: held-out episodes having a valid original 10-step window
inference_limit: Acceptance is empirical on held-out episodes, not a population-rate confidence guarantee.
